facts.claim: OLCC recreational retailer licenses by city
facts.source_name: Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission, Cannabis Business Licenses (all)
facts.verify: Parse the xlsx, filter License Type containing 'Retail' (795 rows), and extract the city from PhysicalAddress by taking the tokens before ' OR <zip>'. Multi-word city names need an explicit list or the parse truncates them.
facts.note: 795 licensed retailers against 678 recording sales in Aug 2026: licensed is not the same as trading, same distinction as New York. Portland's 231 includes roughly 9 addresses in the Washington and Clackamas county portions of the city; Multnomah County alone holds 222. Gresham (6) and Troutdale (1) are separate cities within Multnomah and are NOT part of Portland's count.

gaps: Legalization and first-sale dates: Measure 91 (2014) and the start of recreational sales need a primary OLCC or Oregon Secretary of State citation before either appears on the page.
Municipal opt-out count: OLCC publishes opted-out cities and counties. Pull the current list before writing the opt-out sentence.
Per-city retailer counts for Portland, Eugene, Salem, Bend: needed for city pages. OLCC publishes an active-licenses file that can be grouped by city.
